original_test_intent: Verify both switch ASIC temperature resources across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, with identity, description, reading, units, state and freshness mapped to the correct physical switch devices and approved silicon SPEC.
original_method: Prove common target identity; obtain the two-switch board/fabric topology; collect complete command views and both Web rows in a bounded interval; map each ordinal to device/location and telemetry source; normalize fields and compare to switch-chip limits without clearing logs or changing switch configuration.
manual_activity: A platform/fabric reviewer approves SWITCH0/1-to-ASIC mapping and chip limits, then visually confirms both Web resources and five-view comparison.
safety_requirements: Do not reset/reconfigure switches or ports
Capture full lists and page context
agent_execution_scope: Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
engineer_actions: Approve device map and chip SPEC
Resolve swapped, missing or divergent switch evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A literal `TEMP_SWITCH0~1` read does not enumerate two switch ASICs; generic grep and truncated fallback cannot prove topology or five-view agreement.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture complete command views and two explicit UI resources, keyed to the approved switch-device/board map and load context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The two-member five-view scope and timing metadata remain; generic clear, truncation and literal-range assumptions are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a two-row matrix keyed by physical switch ASIC and board location, attaching source identity, load context, five timestamped fields and chip-limit outcome.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds device identity and distinguishes ASIC junction from switch regulator telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Correct-looking temperatures can be swapped between two switches or taken from the regulator domain.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Port mapping may describe connectivity rather than sensor location; the component telemetry map remains authoritative.

project_override_considerations: Define switch ASIC identities, board locations, topology, telemetry sources, chip limits and tolerance. The adjacent TEMP_SW_VR case remains independent.
expected_evidence: Switch ASIC/board/fabric topology and SWITCH0/1 map
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Two protected Web rows and page context
No-switch/SDR/thermal mutation or log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target two switch sensors across five views. Generic clear and DeepSeek incompleteness are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Device topology, access and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if switch ordinals cannot be mapped after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Prevents display-order, generic grep or regulator evidence from passing two physical switch-ASIC checks.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two fabric switches can have different traffic and cooling, so ordinals and similar temperatures do not prove identity. The ASIC junction measurement and voltage-regulator temperature also reflect different thermal paths; physical component mapping is necessary before cross-view or limit comparison.
